title: Operations
summary: Claims management delivers end-to-end processing from FNOL through coverage verification, triage and adjuster assignment, analytics-driven SIU investigations, a defined settlement workflow with supervisory approvals and compliant payments, and post-settlement subrogation and closure with ongoing reserve monitoring. Onboarding centers on a centralized CRM with secure API-sharing to policy and claims platforms, enforceable data governance, ongoing quality checks, and a five-step digital onboarding flow to optimize the first-year experience. Analytics provides fraud oversight via real-time dashboards and monthly loss/recovery reporting, while policy lifecycle management optimizes applications, renewals, and terminations with governance, automation, refunds rules, lienholder notifications, and regulatory archival.

guidance_context.parent_topic_description: Operations manages claims processing, settlement, fraud detection, and recovery activities.

nodes.title: Claims Management
nodes.summary: Claims Management starts with FNOL, capturing incident and policy data, verifying coverage, and triaging by severity, type, and complexity to assign to the appropriate adjuster with authority and reserves; SIUs conduct fraud investigations using analytics, surveillance, interviews, and digital forensics, coordinating with law enforcement as needed. The settlement workflow prescribes defined steps, required documentation, and supervisory approval for offers above thresholds, with payments issued via approved methods (EFT/ACH or checks) in compliance with state timelines. Subrogation seeks recovery from responsible third parties post-settlement, with legal counsel and recovery tracking, and closure finalizes the claim after all payments are made, while ongoing monitoring for audits, reserve adequacy, and management review of reopened claims occurs.

guidance_context.parent_topic_description: Operations manages claims processing, settlement, fraud detection, and recovery activities.

nodes.title: Claims Closure
nodes.summary: The Claims Closure process finalizes claims after all payments are made and no further actions are expected, with closed claims monitored for audits and reserve adequacy, while reopened claims are tracked and highlighted for management review.

nodes.title: Claims Processing
nodes.summary: First Notice of Loss (FNOL) triggers the claims lifecycle by capturing incident details, policy information, and initial verification from the policyholder. The claim is triaged by severity, claim type (auto, property, liability), and complexity to determine the appropriate resolution path and assign it to the most suitable adjuster or team with the necessary authority and reserves.

They deploy a range of tools—including data analytics, surveillance, interviews, and digital forensics—and coordinate with law enforcement or prosecutors for criminal action or civil recovery, while ensuring meticulous case tracking and regulatory compliance throughout the process.

nodes.summary: Policy lifecycle management centers on efficiently handling application, renewal, and termination across all lines, ensuring accurate data, timely underwriting, and compliant administration.
